newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Precious Shipping to buy ships.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Precious Shipping to buy ships.

text.p: Precious Shipping Plc, Thailand's major shipping firm, has signed a memorandum of agreement to buy six vessels worth 2.32 billion baht, the company said on Friday.
The vessels, two of them new and four used, will be bought in the next six months, Precious Shipping said in a statement to the Thai stock exchange.
The two new vessels, each with a capacity of 18,000 deadweight tonnes (dwt), will be built in 1998 and 1999 in South Korea.
The other four vessls, to be purchased from Liberia and Panama, have a capacity of 25,413 dwt, 27,881 dwt, 23,732 dwt and 23,720 dwt respectively, it added.
Precious Shipping said it bought the vessels to accommodate expanding business. Its charter rates have risen to US$6,200 per vessel per day from US$5,800 last quarter.
